question:
Using only the captured sources, which ROR child relationships are recorded
for the National Cancer Institute (ror:040gcmg81), and what do the captured
Wikidata statements and identifier crosswalks support or leave unresolved
about its identity and hierarchy? Distinguish source assertions from current
truth, preserve qualifications, and explain coverage limits. Cite retrieved
source records for claims and links. Use at most six findings, up to two genuine
conflicts, and 350 words of model-authored analysis.

grounded_media.input_policy: Only returned pixels and audited source/locator labels from each successful read_media call; deferred until finish preflight
grounded_media.acceptance: Grounded output construction, not automated semantic acceptance

schema_policy.synthesis_facts: Actual inventoried scope/retrieved IDs, declared attachments, inspected availability and successful returned pixel locators; source authoring labels never override current-run observations
schema_policy.coverage: Actual complete unfiltered snapshot-bound catalog cursor chains inventory returned graph scope; edge proofs require complete read_evidence records
schema_policy.finish: Compact status/target intent checked before separate budgeted report synthesis; final guards remain required
schema_policy.read_ids: Exact catalog card IDs, top-level read IDs or explicit graph edge proof IDs; successful full reads are retained and not repeated
schema_policy.inspect_ids: Observed media records excluding successful inspect_media calls
schema_policy.media_read_ids: Local catalog profile is text-only; raw-pixel requests blocked before MCP
schema_policy.video_offsets: 1-4 offsets per call; defaults from inspected suggestions; novelty enforced before MCP; failed reads consume none
schema_policy.citation_ids: Actual complete read_evidence records only; metadata cards never grant citation/proof credit
schema_policy.media_locators: Only actual audit evidence-ID/returned-PTS pairs; no observations when no pixels were inspected

dataset.name: Captured ROR/Wikidata source units
dataset.license: CC0 structured data; linked media excluded
dataset.description: Complete individually addressable selected statements, relationships and identity candidates. Source assertions, not independently verified facts. Edit/retrieval dates are not relationship validity dates. Projection records a captured assertion, not present-day truth. Crosswalks never merge identities; reciprocity does not establish independent corroboration. Linked media was not imported.

workflow_coverage.scope_note: Actual returned graph scope and source co-mentions; metadata inventory is not source retrieval or analytical adequacy.
